summary: Iteration 007 adds a full text-to-speech (TTS) spoken output layer to Bay-Max. A modular TTS provider abstraction supports three backends: NullTTSProvider (silent/testing), KokoroTTSProvider (default real backend using Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0), and PiperTTSProvider (placeholder for MIT-licensed Piper). A SpeechService wraps providers with a bounded speech queue, event tracking, and optional audio playback via sounddevice. TTS is integrated into the LiveRuntime so proactive responses are automatically synthesized and optionally played aloud. API endpoints expose TTS backend info and speech state. A local verification script and workflow are provided for webcam + TTS testing on non-headless machines. Kokoro WAV synthesis was verified on the coding machine (3.45s WAV generated). Audio playback requires PortAudio which was not available on the headless Sol machine; playback is honestly marked not_run. All 296 automated tests pass (256 existing + 40 new). Lint clean.
